rule.tie_margin_note: OPEN in the spec (contract 10.8); a visible, adjustable value, not a recommendation
rule.unmeasured_note: measured_first: a candidate with a valid admitted measurement beats any candidate without one; with none measured the cheapest unmeasured one may win (public and internal only, flagged provisional). cost_first: cost class first, as before

os_family_aliases_note: the analysis names the family macos; the catalog and the node say darwin

owner_policy_defaults.note: an environment is available when an access to it is DETECTED on the machine (a signed-in CLI, a key, an installed local runtime, a license): presence and session only. Nothing starts closed. The owner may close a subtype, an environment, an access or a machine in his profile (closed_by_owner); that is his choice, recorded and undoable. Whether an automated use of a vendor's CLI is allowed is a separate list (automated_use_cleared)

docker.status: argv built and tested; no image is built and no environment ran inside it (UNTESTED)

env_base_note: the only variables a node passes through to an environment besides the NAMES an environment declares in env_pass; values are never logged
